pasta.name: Lasagna
pasta.description: Simple lasagna often topped with cheese. Oven baked pasta dish filled with layers of pasta plates, sauces and fillings of choice.

pasta.name: Macaroni
pasta.description: Tiny bent tubes of pasta. Good four soups and thinner sauces. Usually cookes pretty fast.

pasta.name: Fettuccine
pasta.description: Thin flat pasta. Good with sauce, simple and good for any dinner.

pasta.name: Spaghetti
pasta.description: Long thin strands of pasta. A classic choice that works well with tomato sauces, meat sauces and simple oil based sauces.

pasta.name: Penne
pasta.description: Short hollow tubes with angled ends. Works well with thick sauces because the sauce can get trapped inside the pasta.

pasta.name: Fusilli
pasta.description: Short spiral shaped pasta. The twists hold onto sauces well and make it a good choice for pasta salads and creamy sauces.

pasta.name: Ravioli
pasta.description: Small pieces of filled pasta. Common fillings include cheese, meat, spinach and vegetables. Usually served with a simple sauce.

pasta.name: Tagliatelle
pasta.description: Long flat ribbons of pasta. Similar to fettuccine and especially good with rich meat sauces and creamy sauces.

pasta.name: Linguine
pasta.description: Long and slightly flattened strands of pasta. Often served with seafood, pesto or lighter cream and tomato sauces.

pasta.name: Rigatoni
pasta.description: Large ridged tubes of pasta. The ridges and wide shape make it good for thick sauces, baked pasta dishes and hearty meals.

pasta.name: Orzo
pasta.description: Small rice shaped pasta. Often used in soups, salads and one pot dishes, but can also be served with vegetables and sauces.

pasta.name: Pappardelle
pasta.description: Very wide flat ribbons of pasta. Its large surface works especially well with rich and hearty sauces such as ragù.

pasta.name: Farfalle
pasta.description: Bow tie shaped pasta with a pinched center. Works well in pasta salads and with light tomato, cream or vegetable sauces.

pasta.name: Tortellini
pasta.description: Small ring shaped filled pasta. Often filled with cheese or meat and served with a simple sauce, broth or pesto.

pasta.name: Cannelloni
pasta.description: Large tubes of pasta traditionally filled with meat, cheese or vegetables and baked in tomato or cream sauce.

pasta.name: Conchiglie
pasta.description: Shell shaped pasta that can hold sauce inside its curved shape. Good with chunky tomato sauces, cheese sauces and vegetables.

pasta.name: Angel Hair
pasta.description: Very thin long strands of pasta. Cooks quickly and works best with light sauces, olive oil, fresh tomatoes and delicate ingredients.

pasta.name: Gnocchi
pasta.description: Small soft dumplings traditionally made with potatoes and flour. Good with creamy sauces, pesto, tomato sauce or browned butter.
